sub_items.description: 2022 police bodycam footage of Tyler Robinson making a vehicle crash report; Robinson uses "my car" and his mother "shuttles" – contrasted with the federal text messages' use of "vehicle."
Brooksby press-conference audio clip – phone call from retired detective friend at 8:02 p.m. on the 11th.
Brooksby press-conference audio clip – statement that during the call Tyler had "suicidal ideations" and was being directed to a remote Washington County area; parents convinced him otherwise.

Brooksby press-conference audio clip – statement that Tyler came in willingly because he was "fearful of a SWAT team hit" and being shot by law enforcement; negotiation included a "delicate and as soft as possible" reception.
Lance's Instagram Halloween-era post captioned "I forgot to post my boyfriend is the best. Love you." (Handle later removed.)
Lance's Instagram post including a photo of Tyler with a mustache; presented as evidence of the romantic relationship.

Washington County Sheriff's Office social-media retirement-celebration post (image with Brooksby on the left) captioned: "Today, we celebrated the career of Detective Mike Mitchell. After over 24 years of serving … starting in the jail back in 1999. Sheriff Brooksby and Detective Mitchell both had some wonderful stories to share."
Photograph of a person in a black suit and dark sunglasses with a strap hanging from a bag, taken in the UVU food court; supplied by source "Nick."
TMZ-obtained neighborhood surveillance footage showing the shooter walking past a residential driveway twice on the day of the shooting; Lyman's gray CRV visible in the distance.

Audio/video clip of Phil Lyman speaking to Kayleigh McEnany about his aunt's driveway being in the TMZ footage, his gray CRV being parked there ~10 minutes before the shooter walked by, and his return to the house with a friend afterward; describes family ownership of approximately twelve homes on the street.

Audio clip of Phil Lyman on Alex Jones describing being at the east end of the venue, hearing a "loud boom," retreating behind retaining walls, and encountering two "very goth, very black" girls who said the shot was "just right over there" and were not running; one girl reportedly said "Go f yourselves" while looking at fleeing people.
Audio clip of Phil Lyman on a local Utah news station describing being backstage, throwing hats, and standing next to the stage before going to "meet some friends" (away from the stage).

Phil Lyman's Instagram video dated September 10, 2025, ~11:30 PM, in which he states he is driving from Salt Lake to Blanding, stopping by UVU campus to thank police, and recounts that he was "very close this morning" to where Charlie Kirk was, met Charlie backstage, decided to "go up top," and concluded the shot was a "200 yard kill shot" from the roof.

Shane Lyman's Instagram post presenting a map of the area near his grandmother's house and stating he retraced the shooter's steps with friends and took "pictures in the exact place that the security cameras caught him"; image shows Converse-brand footprints.

Shane Lyman's Instagram post showing side-by-side staircase photos of Shane and three friends in the same staircase configuration as the blurred suspect image; host notes she could not identify two of the individuals on his friends list.
Comment from "Marzy" discussing poisoned/keyholed bullet mechanics for fragmentation damage.
Comment from "Caitlyn Derrian" describing the host as a model of real journalism.
Comment from "Kristen Theoret" stating the people closest to Charlie are simply moving on and that the host is the only one capable of unraveling the truth.
Comment from "Bitsy" stating "The whole world is a stage … it's all lies."
Comment from "Miranda Allen" offering prayers for protection over investigators.
Comment from "Cassie" stating many social-media figures have lost credibility by not asking questions about the shooting.
Comment from "Kaya" stating "It's 1963 all over again" and referencing Ian being mentioned.
Host verbal reference to the account of a vetted anonymous source about Tyler Robinson's surrender, arrest and family (not shown)
Host verbal reference to the footage she asked Tiffany Barker for and did not receive (not shown)
Host verbal reference to Tiffany Barker's Instagram explanation of why they went back that early in the morning (not shown)
Host verbal reference to the footage and side-angle image of the microphone on Charlie Kirk after the shot (not shown)

nodes.name: Mike Mitchell
nodes.description: Former Washington County Sheriff's Office detective identified by host as the "retired detective friend" referenced obliquely by Brooksby at the September 11 press conference; reportedly retired in January (2024) after 24+ years per the Washington County retirement post.

nodes.name: "Nick" (UVU Student – Pseudonym)
nodes.description: Anonymous 20-year-old UVU student who worked on Phil Lyman's gubernatorial campaign and served as host's boots-on-the-ground contact; name withheld.

nodes.description: Nephew of Phil Lyman; posted public Instagram content retracing the shooter's route near his grandmother's house; profile subsequently set to private after host inquiry.

nodes.description: Interviewer; conducted the on-camera interview with Phil Lyman in which he described his car in the driveway of the TMZ footage house.

nodes.name: Ian Carroll
nodes.description: Independent investigator conducting parallel Utah-based investigation; reportedly offered a tour by Phil Lyman.

nodes.name: Mike Mitchell Public Record Anomaly
nodes.description: Persistent anomaly: a 24+ year Washington County detective appears to have minimal public footprint aside from a single retirement-celebration post, despite Brooksby's stated intent to protect his identity.

nodes.name: Brooksby Suicide Narrative Discrepancy
nodes.description: Persistent discrepancy between Brooksby's claim that Tyler Robinson had "suicidal ideations" and Brooksby's separate claim that Tyler came in willingly out of fear of being shot – two states that the host argues cannot coexist.

nodes.name: Robinson Apartment Staging Allegation
nodes.description: Allegation by the Robinson family (via host's source) that Tyler's room in the apartment shared with Lance was staged post-arrest, including placement of a "furry bed" purportedly to associate Lance's attributes with Tyler.

nodes.name: Phil Lyman Proximity and Behavior Investigation
nodes.description: Composite investigative target tracking Phil Lyman's documented proximity to the shooting scene (driveway, venue, rooftop area, post-shooting media appearances), his in-person contact with "Nick," and his refusal to share imagery with the host's team.

nodes.name: UVU Campus Familiarity Question
nodes.description: Persistent question (raised by host's source) regarding how Tyler Robinson – accepted to Utah State, not UVU, and reportedly never having stepped on UVU campus – would have known the rooftop layout, the L0y Center sightline, and Charlie Kirk's exact seating position.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson uses "car" rather than "vehicle" in 2022 police bodycam footage
claims.claim: The 2022 police bodycam audio presented in the episode shows Tyler Robinson referring to "his car" and his mother "shuttling over from her car," contrasting with the federal text messages' vocabulary.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original 2022 bodycam video and full transcript; compare against the released federal text messages.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson uses "vehicle" rarely in ordinary speech
claims.claim: Host states (via commentary on A-1171.1) that Robinson's everyday use of "car" rather than "vehicle" is typical of ordinary American English speakers.
claims.investigative_direction: Independent corpus sampling of Robinson's other recorded speech; comparison with general American English usage.

claims.label: Brooksby received a phone call about the shooter at 8:02 p.m. on the 11th from a retired detective friend
claims.claim: Brooksby stated at his press conference that he received a phone call at 8:02 p.m. on the 11th from a friend who is a retired Washington County detective informing him of the shooter's identity.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference call logs and the court filings already referenced by Brooksby (court documents where the friend was named as a "retired Washington County deputy").

claims.label: Brooksby attempted to protect the retired detective's identity despite his public-record career
claims.claim: Brooksby stated that he did not initially disclose the friend as a former detective and only referenced him generally as "retired law enforcement"; he argued that the court documents were what ultimately revealed the title.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the cited court documents and compare Brooksby's public statements with the actual filed text.

claims.label: Brooksby stated Tyler Robinson had suicidal ideations during the initial phone call
claims.claim: Brooksby stated that during the initial 8:02 p.m. call, the retired detective reported that Tyler had "suicidal ideations" and was being directed to a remote area in Washington County.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited press-conference audio and any internal law-enforcement notes from the call.

claims.label: Brooksby stated Tyler Robinson came in willingly out of fear of being shot by law enforcement
claims.claim: Brooksby stated that Tyler came in to Brooksby's office willingly as part of a negotiated "delicate and as soft as possible" reception because he was "fearful of a SWAT team hit" and being shot by law enforcement.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain any negotiated-surrender documentation; reconcile with the contemporaneous suicide-ideation claim.

claims.label: Lance's Instagram posts establish a romantic relationship with Tyler Robinson
claims.claim: Host presents Lance's Halloween-era Instagram caption ("I forgot to post my boyfriend is the best. Love you.") and a photo of Tyler with a mustache as evidence that Tyler and Lance were in a romantic relationship.
claims.investigative_direction: Recover archived versions of Lance's Instagram handle (host notes it has since been removed); cross-reference with any retained screenshots in the investigative file.

claims.label: Mike Mitchell retired from the Washington County Sheriff's Office after 24+ years
claims.claim: The Washington County Sheriff's Office retirement-celebration post states that Detective Mike Mitchell served for "over 24 years … starting in the jail back in 1999."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against Washington County personnel records and any prior news coverage of Mitchell's career.

claims.label: The retirement-celebration post is the only public trace of Mike Mitchell
claims.claim: Host states she was unable to find any other public news trace of Mike Mitchell despite his 24+ year career, and presents the retirement post as the sole located artifact.
claims.investigative_direction: Conduct independent newspaper archive search (local Utah papers, Provo, St. George) and Washington County internal award/honor records.

claims.label: The suicidal-ideation and fear-of-being-shot accounts are mutually exclusive
claims.claim: Host argues that the two Brooksby statements – that Tyler had suicidal ideations, and that Tyler came in willingly because he feared being shot – cannot both be true simultaneously.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek clarification from Brooksby or from the Washington County Sheriff's Office on which account is operative.

claims.label: Phil Lyman's vehicle was in the driveway of the TMZ footage location 10–19 minutes before the shooter walked by
claims.claim: In his Kayleigh McEnany interview, Phil Lyman stated that his aunt's driveway (visible in the TMZ footage) is where he parked his gray CRV approximately 10 minutes before the shooter walked past; Lyman separately described the driveway as being 19 minutes away from the shooter's walk-by.
claims.investigative_direction: Timestamp the TMZ footage independently and reconcile with Lyman's stated parking time.

claims.label: Phil Lyman's family owns approximately twelve homes on the relevant street
claims.claim: In the Kayleigh McEnany interview, Phil Lyman describes the area as his childhood neighborhood and his relatives' neighborhood; host counts approximately twelve homes as owned by the Lyman family in the area.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull county property records for the relevant street and verify ownership chain.

claims.label: Phil Lyman publicly described "two goth girls" as unfrightened near the shooting scene on Alex Jones
claims.claim: In an Alex Jones interview, Phil Lyman recounted being at the east end of the venue, retreating behind retaining walls, and encountering two "very goth, very black" girls who were not running; he reported that one girl said "Go f yourselves" while looking down at fleeing people.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited Alex Jones segment and any witness statements regarding the two individuals described.

claims.label: Phil Lyman stated on local Utah news that he was backstage with Charlie Kirk before the shooting
claims.claim: In a local Utah news interview, Phil Lyman stated he was backstage, throwing hats, and standing next to the stage before going to "meet some friends" away from the stage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited local Utah news segment; compare timeline with the Alex Jones account.

claims.label: Phil Lyman posted an Instagram video on September 10, 2025 at ~11:30 PM describing proximity and a "200 yard kill shot"
claims.claim: In his own Instagram video, Phil Lyman stated he was driving from Salt Lake to Blanding on the night of the shooting, stopped by UVU campus to thank officers, and recounted being "very close this morning" to where Charlie Kirk was, meeting Charlie backstage, deciding to "go up top," and concluding it was a "200 yard kill shot" from the roof.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm upload timestamp and metadata on Instagram; obtain the original unedited video if still available.

claims.label: Shane Lyman publicly retraced the shooter's steps near his grandmother's house
claims.claim: Shane Lyman's Instagram post presented a map of the area near his grandmother's house and stated he and friends retraced the shooter's steps, taking "pictures in the exact place that the security cameras caught him"; the image showed Converse-brand footprints.
claims.investigative_direction: Recover archived version of Shane Lyman's Instagram post; verify the grandmother's house address against the property records already referenced by Phil Lyman.

claims.label: Shane Lyman's Instagram included side-by-side staircase photos with three unidentified individuals
claims.claim: Shane Lyman's Instagram post showed side-by-side staircase photos of Shane and three friends in the same staircase configuration as the blurred suspect image; host states she could not identify two of the individuals on his friends list.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the two friends via cross-reference with Shane's social graph or via direct outreach.

claims.label: Phil Lyman showed up at "Nick's" home uninvited and asked questions about the host's investigation
claims.claim: Per Nick's account to host, Phil Lyman messaged Nick for his address (something he had not previously had), arrived at Nick's home, looked out the window nervously, sat at the table, and asked questions about the host's investigation.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain any corroborating records (Ring/doorbell footage, phone logs, text screenshots) and a contemporaneous written statement from Nick.

claims.label: Phil Lyman offered independent investigator Ian Carroll a tour of the area
claims.claim: Per Nick's account, Phil Lyman offered a tour of the area to Ian Carroll, who was conducting a separate on-the-ground investigation; Nick found this "weird" given that Lyman lives four hours away.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via Ian Carroll's own public statements and any travel/timeline records.

claims.label: Nick supplied the black-suit food-court photo to host
claims.claim: Host states that Nick sent the food-court photo of a person in a black suit and dark sunglasses with a strap hanging from a bag into the tips box early in the investigation.
claims.investigative_direction: Recover the original image and metadata; identify the individual depicted.

claims.label: Host acknowledges Marzy's keyholing-fragmentation bullet theory as new information
claims.claim: Host states she was previously unaware of "keyholing" and acknowledges Marzy's comment about intentionally keyholed rounds for tumbling/fragmentation damage as new to her.
claims.investigative_direction: Independent forensic review of recovered bullet(s) for keyholing signatures.

claims.label: Host concurs with Caitlyn Derrian's characterization of her journalism
claims.claim: Host expresses gratitude for Caitlyn Derrian's supportive comment and concurs with the framing.
claims.investigative_direction: N/A – rhetorical/statement of self-positioning, recorded for traceability only.

claims.label: Host concurs with multiple commenters that the people closest to Charlie are not investigating
claims.claim: Host concurs with Kristen Theoret's, Cassie's, and Kaya's comments that the people closest to Charlie Kirk have not been asking questions about the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Inventory public statements/actions (or silence) by named individuals close to Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Host concurs with Phil Lyman proximity pattern and shared prayer requests
claims.claim: Host concurs with Bitsy's comment about a "stage" narrative; concurs with Miranda Allen's prayer request and reports that she also prays for protection over investigators.
claims.investigative_direction: N/A – rhetorical/statement of self-positioning.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler Robinson Is Not Suicidal According to Her Source
claims.claim: The host says she wanted to get out quickly the information that Tyler Robinson is not suicidal, and that she knows this from her source.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Washington County Sheriff's Office and court records of the surrender call (the 'suicidal ideations' remark) against the host's source. Ask whether the source can document the family's account.
claims.transcript_snippet: I genuinely   wanted to get the information out as soon as  possible that Tyler Robinson is not suicidal.   And I'm going to tell you how I know that.

claims.label: Host Says a Vetted Source Contacted Her Last Week With Answers to Lingering Questions
claims.claim: The host says that last week she was contacted by a source she vetted, whose information answered some of the lingering questions about the investigation (how the surrender worked, the federal text messages, the Dairy Queen photo).
claims.investigative_direction: The source is unnamed and nothing was shown. Ask the host to describe how the source was vetted, or have the source go on record or provide documents.
claims.transcript_snippet: Last week, I have to tell  you, I was contacted by a source who I vetted with   information that answered a lot of the lingering  questions that we've had about the investigation.

claims.label: Host Alleges Feds Withheld Dairy Queen Information and Are Watching the Dairy Queen
claims.claim: The host says the feds withheld information about the Dairy Queen and, as she puts it, are allegedly stalking the Dairy Queen to see who comes in and out. She presents the source's account as one that could answer both questions.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to say what the 'withheld' information is. Ask the Dairy Queen's staff or owners whether law enforcement has been watching the store. FBI and Utah County records of the Dairy Queen photo handling would also help.
claims.transcript_snippet: And why exactly did the   feds withhold that information at Dairy Queen? And  why are they allegedly stalking the Dairy Queen to   see who comes in and out?

claims.label: Host Says Robinson Has Never Confessed and Is Still Pleading Innocence
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Robinson has never confessed, that 'they' acknowledge he has never confessed, and that he is still pleading innocence on the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the charging documents and court filings for any confession or admission. Check Robinson's plea status and any statements by his defense counsel.
claims.transcript_snippet: First and foremost,  Tyler Robinson has never confessed. They   acknowledge that he has never confessed to this  crime and he still uh is pleading innocence on the   shooting.

claims.label: Source Says Robinson Was Bewildered by the Idea He Carved the Casings and Does Not Dispute the Gun Is His
claims.claim: The host says she was told Tyler Robinson was 'bewildered' by the idea that he carved the casings, and that he does not dispute the gun is his.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the casing engraving evidence in the charging documents and with Robinson's defense filings. Ask the host's source for corroboration.
claims.transcript_snippet: In fact, I was told that he was quote  unquote bewildered by the idea that he carved   casings. I should be clear, he does not dispute  the fact that it is his gun at all.

claims.label: Source Says Robinson Is Not a Gun Enthusiast and Does Not Hunt Like His Brothers
claims.claim: The host says that, according to her source, Tyler Robinson is not a gun enthusiast, does not hunt like his brothers do, and is apparently a fisherman.
claims.investigative_direction: Check hunting and fishing licence records, firearm purchase records and Robinson's social media posts. Ask the Robinson family's counsel.
claims.transcript_snippet: but Tyler is not exactly a gun enthusiast. He  doesn't hunt like his other brothers do. In fact,   he's apparently a fisherman.

claims.label: Source Says the Rifle Is a Custom-Made Family Heirloom Inherited by the Firstborn Son
claims.claim: The host says that, according to her source, Tyler Robinson has the gun because it is a custom-made family heirloom and he inherited it as the firstborn son.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for the rifle's make, serial number and ownership history in the ATF trace and the charging documents. Check public statements by the Robinson family or their counsel about how the gun came to Tyler.
claims.transcript_snippet: The reason that he  has that gun in the first place is because it is   in fact a custommade family heirloom. Tyler is  the firstborn son. So he inherited.

claims.label: Source Says the Robinson Family Are Fans of Charlie Kirk and Trump
claims.claim: The host says she is told the Robinson family are fans of Charlie Kirk and of Donald Trump, and that her source said Tyler, like many other conservatives, wished Trump would sometimes tone down his speech and rhetoric.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Robinson family voter registration, donations and public statements. The source is unnamed, so independent corroboration is needed.
claims.transcript_snippet: I am told  that they are fans of Charlie Kirk and they are   fans of Donald Trump. Although this source noted  that Tyler, like many other conservatives have   um expressed,

claims.label: Source Says Robinson Did Not Author the Federal Text Messages
claims.claim: The host says she is told that Tyler Robinson absolutely did not author the text messages, has no idea where they came from, and believes they are entirely fictionalized.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the forensic extraction reports for the messages and the device they came from. Check for any defense motion challenging the messages' authenticity.
claims.transcript_snippet: I am told that Tyler absolutely  did not author those text messages. What text   messages? He has no idea where these messages  came from. Uh believes that they are therefore   entirely fictionalized.

claims.label: Host Says Robinson Does Not Use the Word Vehicle According to the Source
claims.claim: The host says it turns out, per her source, that Tyler Robinson does not actually use words like 'vehicle'.
claims.investigative_direction: Review a larger sample of Robinson's recorded and written speech for use of 'vehicle'. The 2022 bodycam clip aired later in the episode (A-1171.1) is one data point.
claims.transcript_snippet: It turns out, you're  going to be shocked that he doesn't actually   use words like vehicle.

claims.label: Source Says Robinson's Parents Do Not Believe Their Son Committed the Crime
claims.claim: The host says she has learned that Tyler Robinson's father, and his parents, do not believe their son committed the crime. She says this is a far cry from what the media has told us.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for public statements by the Robinson parents or their counsel on their view of Tyler's guilt. Compare with the media accounts, including statements by Governor Cox.
claims.transcript_snippet: of most interest to me. what I've learned is that   his father uh does not believe his parents don't  believe that their son committed this crime.

claims.label: Host Says the Media Story Was That the Father Realized His Son Was Guilty and Phoned a Friend to Persuade Him to Surrender
claims.claim: The host recounts the media narrative that Tyler Robinson's father realized his son was guilty and phoned a friend to help convince him to turn himself in.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace the original media and official source for the father-phones-friend narrative (the Cox press briefings and reporting).
claims.transcript_snippet: the  father realized his son was guilty. So it goes,   right? And then he phoned over a friend to help  him convince his son to turn himself in

claims.label: Source Says the Family Friend, a Former Detective, Told the Family Tyler Had Been Identified as the Shooter
claims.claim: The host says her source told her the 'family friend' was a former detective with the police force and has strong ties to the police station, and that he was the in-between person who informed the Robinson family that Tyler had been identified as the shooter. She presents this as the opposite of the media story.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the retired deputy or detective through court records and the sheriff's office. Compare the call timeline with Brooksby's press-conference account (A-1172.1).
claims.transcript_snippet: That quote unquote family friend   uh who we learned was a former detective with  the police force um at least and so therefore   has strong ties with the police station informed  the family.

claims.label: Source Says the Friend Told Tyler to Turn Himself In Peaceably or Face a SWAT Arrest
claims.claim: The host says she was told, and believes, that the family friend, neighbor and former detective told Tyler he had two options: turn himself in peaceably, or the SWAT team could come in and arrest him and things could get crazy.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Brooksby's statement that Tyler was 'fearful of a SWAT team hit' (A-1172.3) and with the surrender timeline in the charging documents and sheriff's logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: Either you turn  yourself in and everything is peaceable,   or you know, the SWAT team could come in here  and arrest you and things could get crazy.

claims.label: Source Says Robinson Was Called Over, Was Bewildered and Disputed Having Murdered Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: The host says her source told her that Tyler was called over to the house of the family friend, was bewildered, and disputed the idea that he had murdered Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for sworn statements from the family friend, the parents and responding officers describing the conversation. The source is unnamed, so these records are the only route to corroboration.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tyler was called over.   Tyler was bewildered. He disputed the idea  that he had murdered Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Source Says Robinson Has Never Stepped Foot on the UVU Campus
claims.claim: The host says that, according to her source, Tyler Robinson has never even stepped foot on the UVU campus.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Robinson's phone location history, parking and ID records and campus camera footage for any earlier UVU visit. See the charging documents' account of how he reached the Losee Center roof.
claims.transcript_snippet: according uh to my source, Tyler has never even  stepped foot on UVU campus.

claims.label: Host Says Robinson Was Accepted to Utah State University, Not Utah Valley
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Robinson was accepted into Utah State University, not Utah Valley University, and notes this had already been revealed.
claims.investigative_direction: Check university admissions and enrollment records, subject to FERPA, and the reporting that first stated his Utah State admission.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tyler, it turns out,   has which has already been revealed, um  was accepted into Utah State University,   not Utah Valley.

claims.label: Host Says Robinson's Familiarity With the UVU Rooftops and Kirk's Seating Position Is Unexplained
claims.claim: The host says it is unexplained how Tyler Robinson, if he had never been on the UVU campus, became so familiar with the rooftop layout that he knew how to scale across the rooftops to take an almost impossible shot at Charlie Kirk seated under a tent. She guesses that even current UVU students would not know it.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the prosecution's account of how Robinson accessed and traversed the roofs, and any earlier recorded visits to the campus. Interview UVU students and staff on whether the roof route was known.
claims.transcript_snippet: familiar with the rooftop layout of UVU campus. So  familiar that he knew exactly how to scale across   the rooftops

claims.label: Source Says Robinson Was Nearby the Campus That Day and Host Wonders if This Explains the Dairy Queen Photo
claims.claim: The host says her source says Tyler Robinson was nearby the campus that day, and that she is wondering whether this explains the Dairy Queen photo, which never fit into her timeline. She says she is trying to learn more.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the Dairy Queen 6:38 photo timestamp reconciliation and the Washington County surveillance footage. Ask for the source's specifics on where Robinson was near the campus.
claims.transcript_snippet: my source says that Tyler Robinson was nearby the  campus on that day. I'm wondering if that fact,   which I'm trying to learn more information  regarding, explains the Dairy Queen photo

claims.label: Host Says Robinson Went to the Station So He Would Not Risk Being Shot by Police Swarming His Home
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Robinson wanted to go to the police station so that he did not risk accidentally getting shot by police swarming his home, and that the police were 'honest' on the point that he is not suicidal.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with Brooksby's press-conference account and the sheriff's arrest log. Ask whether any SWAT or tactical team was staged at the Robinson home.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um, he wanted to go to the police station so   that he didn't risk accidentally getting shot by  the police swarming his home.

claims.label: Brooksby Clip: He Said It Was Not Unusual for the Retired Friend to Call Him
claims.claim: In the Brooksby press-conference clip aired by the host, Brooksby says he and the retired friend call each other and that it is not unusual for him to get a call from the friend or vice versa.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited clip and the call logs for the 8:02 p.m. call the sheriff described.
claims.transcript_snippet: He he'll we'll call each   other. It's not it's not unusual for me to get  a call from him or vice versa.

claims.label: Brooksby Clip: Friend Knows the Family Through Religious Association and Was Trying to Get Tyler to Come In
claims.claim: In the Brooksby press-conference clip aired by the host, Brooksby relays his friend's call: the friend said he knows the family through religious association, that Tyler is in Washington County, and that they were working on trying to get him to come in 'involuntarily' (probably 'voluntarily').
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited press-conference audio to confirm whether Brooksby said 'voluntarily' or 'involuntarily'. Identify the friend's religious association with the family (court filings named him).
claims.transcript_snippet: I know the family through religious  association and uh he's in he's in Washington   County now and we're working on trying to get  him to come involuntarily.

claims.label: Host Says Nick Told Her on Day Two He Worked on Phil Lyman's Gubernatorial Campaign
claims.claim: The host says that on about day two of the investigation her UVU-student contact 'Nick' told her he worked on Phil Lyman's gubernatorial campaign, in which Lyman ran against Governor Cox and lost.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Utah campaign finance and staff filings for Lyman's 2024 gubernatorial campaign. Nick is a pseudonym; confirm his role through the host.
claims.transcript_snippet: right away he   told me on like day two of the investigation that  he worked on Phil Lyman's gubernatorial campaign,   Phil Lyman ran against Governor, the current  Governor Cox, and he lost.

claims.label: Host Says Nick Cold-Called Her With Phil Lyman on the Phone Around Day Three
claims.claim: The host says that around day three of the investigation Nick cold-called her with Phil Lyman on the line, and Nick insisted Lyman was a fantastic person with tons of resources who knew the area and could help.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain phone records or messages showing the call. Ask the host to confirm the date. Lyman's own account of why he joined the call would help.
claims.transcript_snippet: Nick cold calls me and Phil Lyman's on the phone,   okay? Like I said, he ran for governor

claims.label: Host Says Tiffany Barker Gave Information but Never Sent Footage Showing She Was There
claims.claim: The host says Tiffany Barker gave her a ton of information but never sent her directly any footage that could verify she was there when Charlie Kirk was shot, and says metadata would show where and when a video was taken and on whose iPhone.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Barker to share the original files with metadata. Check the Good Morning America segment and her public Instagram for the footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: She never sent  me directly any footage that could verify that she   was there when Charlie Kirk got shot.

claims.label: Host Says Nick Learned the Black-Suit Food-Court Photo Came From Tiffany Barker's Mother
claims.claim: The host says she learned from Nick that the photo of the person in a black suit and dark sunglasses, which Nick had sent to her tips box, had come from Tiffany Barker's mother.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace the photo's origin through the earliest social media posts and its metadata. Ask Nick and the Barker family how the image reached Nick.
claims.transcript_snippet: I learned from Nick that  the photo of the person who was wearing that black   suit in dark sunglasses had come from Tiffany  Barker's mother.

claims.label: Host Says Barker Told Her Phil Lyman Put Her on Good Morning America and Her Sister Ran With Him
claims.claim: The host says Tiffany Barker told her that Phil Lyman is the person who put her on Good Morning America, and that her sister ran with Lyman as lieutenant governor.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Utah election filings for Lyman's 2024 running mate. Ask ABC / Good Morning America how the Barker segment was booked.
claims.transcript_snippet: Well, then I told you she  told us actually Phil Lyman is the person that   put me on Good Morning America. My sister ran  with him as Lieutenant Governor.

claims.label: Host Says Phil Lyman Was Very Involved in the Immediate Communications About the Shooting
claims.claim: The host says she learned that Phil Lyman himself was very involved in all the communications that immediately went out about the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for the source of this. Look for Lyman's press statements and posts on September 10, and who he communicated with that day.
claims.transcript_snippet: but then I learned that Phil Lyman himself was  very involved in all the communications that   immediately went out about the shooting

claims.label: Host Says the TMZ Footage Shows the Shooter Walking Past the House Twice and Lyman Says He Just Missed Him
claims.claim: The host says the TMZ footage showed the shooter walking by the house twice that day, and that Phil Lyman says he had pulled into that driveway minutes earlier and had just missed the shooter.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the TMZ neighborhood-camera footage with its original timestamps, and compare against Lyman's account and the official timeline of the shooter's route.
claims.transcript_snippet: TMZ footage which showed the shooter walking twice  that day by this house. In fact, Phil Lyman says   that he had just pulled into that driveway minutes  earlier and had just missed the shooter.

claims.label: Host Says McEnany Put Lyman's Parking at 11:30 and the Footage at 11:49, 19 Minutes Apart, While Lyman Says About 10 Minutes
claims.claim: In the clip, Kayleigh McEnany says Lyman told her he parked there at 11:30 a.m. and the footage was taken at 11:49 a.m., a gap of 19 minutes; Lyman answers that he parked there 'probably 10 minutes before he walked by.' The host reiterates the 19-minute figure.
claims.investigative_direction: Reconcile the two numbers by timestamping the TMZ footage and Lyman's vehicle location data. Ask Lyman's office which figure is right.
claims.transcript_snippet: You said that in that footage is your   driveway and you parked there at 11:30 a. m. We  know this footage that you're looking at was   taken at 11:49 a. m.

claims.label: Lyman Clip: Driveway Is His Aunt's, and He Returned There With a Friend After the Shooting
claims.claim: In the McEnany clip, Lyman says the driveway belongs to his aunt, not him, that he parked his gray CRV there, and that after the shooting he took a friend and went back to his aunt's house when they thought they had the shooter. He says people were combing the backyard and helicopters were overhead.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the property owner and the date and time of Lyman's return. Check police records for the backyard search at that address.
claims.transcript_snippet: They thought they had the the shooter.   Uh so I took a friend of mine. We went back to  my aunt's house.

claims.label: Lyman Clip: He Got Up at 6:00 to Drive Up and Meet Charlie and Had Not Been to Bed Since
claims.claim: In the McEnany clip, Lyman says he got up at 6:00 the previous morning to drive up and meet Charlie and has not been to bed since.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with his stated drive from Blanding and with his later Instagram video about driving from Salt Lake to Blanding. Check his scheduled appearance and arrival time at UVU.
claims.transcript_snippet: I got up yesterday morning at at  6:00 to drive up and and meet Charlie and and I   uh I haven't been I haven't been to bed since then

claims.label: Lyman Clip: Someone Told Him There Was Video of the Shooter Coming Off the Roof and Driving Away With an Individual
claims.claim: In the Alex Jones clip, Lyman says someone came in and told him they had video of the shooter coming off the roof, walking to the parking lot, getting in a car with an individual and driving away. He says this is not the story that came out, that he escaped by another route, and that there are people coordinating this.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Lyman who showed or described this video and obtain it. Compare with the official account of Robinson's escape route.
claims.transcript_snippet: He came  off the roof. He walked up. He came up here to   the uh parking lot, got in the car with with an  individual and they and they drove away. Well,   that's not the story that came.

claims.label: Lyman Clip: He Does Not Believe the Recovered .30-06 Was Ever on the Roof
claims.claim: In the Alex Jones clip, Lyman says he does not believe that the 306 that was shown recovered in the bushes was ever on the roof, and that he thinks it was in the bushes to start with.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with the FBI's chain of custody and photographs of the rifle recovery and the charging documents. Ask Lyman the basis for this belief.
claims.transcript_snippet: I do not believe that that 306 that they showed   recovered in the bushes was ever on the roof. I  think it was in the bushes to start with.

claims.label: Lyman Clip: He Says He Is Not Saying Robinson Was Not on the Roof or Did Not Pull a Trigger
claims.claim: In the Alex Jones clip, Lyman says he is not saying Tyler Robinson was not on the roof and not saying he did not pull a trigger.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited Alex Jones segment. Clarify with Lyman what he is questioning.
claims.transcript_snippet: And now   I'm not saying that that Tyler Robinson wasn't on  the roof. I'm not saying he didn't pull a trigger.

claims.label: Host Says Combining Lyman's Clips She Is Unclear Where He Was When the Shots Rang Out
claims.claim: The host says that when she combines Lyman's clips she is unclear where he was exactly when the shots rang out, whether he was close or felt bad that he was not. She earlier reads the Alex Jones clip as implying he was up high, looking down at the fleeing crowd.
claims.investigative_direction: Place Lyman using event video, photographs and his phone-location data, and compare the three accounts (east end, next to the stage, 'up top').
claims.transcript_snippet: When I   combine those clips, I'm kind of unclear as to  where he was exactly when the shots rang out,   if he was close or if he felt bad that he wasn't  close.

claims.label: Host Says She Hopes Lyman Will Send Her Videos and That He May No Longer Want to Help
claims.claim: The host says she hopes Phil Lyman will answer and send her videos, which would be 'case closed', and that maybe he does not want to help anymore.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host or Lyman's office whether the request was made and whether Lyman holds any video of the day.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um and again, hopefully he will answer and   he will just send me some videos and uh that  will be yeah, that'll be uh case closed

claims.label: Host Says Lyman Inserted Himself Into the Story and Now Claims to Be Under Attack When Asked Basic Questions
claims.claim: The host says Lyman cannot insert himself and then pretend he is under attack when people ask him basic questions. She says it is very weird for a gubernatorial candidate to arrive at a 20-year-old's house.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for Lyman's public statements responding to questions about the case, and for the Nick visit described elsewhere (C-1314).
claims.transcript_snippet: But you can't insert yourself and then   pretend you're under attack when people then go,  "Hey, can you answer some basic questions?"

claims.label: Host Says Her Gut Instinct Is That This Was a Military Operation
claims.claim: The host says her gut instinct, based on everything she has seen, the lingering questions and other leads she is working on, is that the assassination was a military operation.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host which leads she is working on and which facts support the military reading, and compare with the documented military-adjacent personnel around the event.
claims.transcript_snippet: my gut instinct is that this was a military  operation. Uh based off everything that I've seen   and the lingering questions that I have and some  other leads that we are working on, that's how   I feel.

claims.label: Host Says the Mitchell Name in That Area Kept Coming Up for the Air Force
claims.claim: The host says that, while trying to find Mike Mitchell, she could find the Mitchell family, and while she does not know if it is his family, the Mitchell name in that area was coming up for the Air Force.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Utah and Washington County Air Force and Hill AFB personnel and obituary records for Mitchell families. Confirm whether any relate to the retired detective.
claims.transcript_snippet: I could find the Mitchell   family. I don't know if it's his family, but the  Mitchell name in that area was coming up for like   Air Force.

claims.label: Host Says Brooksby Showed Nervous Energy by Volunteering That the Call Was Not Unusual
claims.claim: The host says she thinks Brooksby shows some nervous energy when he says the retired friend's call to him was totally usual, since nobody had said it was weird.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the unedited press-conference video and compare with the sheriff's account of the call.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think Brooksby has some nervous energy  there when he's like, "Oh, he called me. That's   just totally usual. That's not weird."

claims.label: Host Says Barker Repeatedly Asked Her to Send Viewers to Her Instagram to Explain Why They Went Early
claims.claim: The host says Tiffany Barker has repeatedly asked her to send viewers to her Instagram, where Barker explains why they decided to go back that early in the morning. The host found the interview odd given the shooter was still at large.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Barker's Instagram explanation and her timeline for the Good Morning America appearance.
claims.transcript_snippet: She has asked us repeatedly to send   you guys to her Instagram where she explains why  uh her why they decided to go back that early in   the morning.

claims.label: Host Says Max Blumenthal Published a Bunch of Articles Last Week With More Coming
claims.claim: The host says Max Blumenthal published a bunch of articles on the Kirk case last week and she thinks he has more coming out.
claims.investigative_direction: List Blumenthal's Grayzone articles for the week of September 22, 2025 and check what claims they make.
claims.transcript_snippet: Maybe uh Max Blumenthal dropping uh he dropped   a bunch of articles last week and I think he's  got more coming out.

claims.label: Host Says Those Close to Charlie Could Name the Donors Who Were Pressuring Him
claims.claim: The host says those close to Charlie Kirk could at the very least name the donors who were pressuring him and tell the truth about what was happening there, and that they will not.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile the donor names reported in Kirk's texts and in reporting about the pressure campaign. Ask TPUSA staff whether they will comment.
claims.transcript_snippet: They could at the   very least name the donors, get a little bit of  revenge. Name the donors who were pressuring him.   Tell the truth about what was happening there.

claims.label: Host Says She Called Ian to Say Lyman Is Unlikely to Give Him a Tour Because It Went Sideways With Nick
claims.claim: The host says she called Ian, who the existing draft identifies as Ian Carroll, to tell him she doubted Lyman would put him on a tour, because Lyman was not being kind to Nick, a Lyman supporter, and she thinks that relationship went sideways.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Ian Carroll whether Lyman offered him a tour and whether the host called him. Confirm the identity of 'Ian'.
claims.transcript_snippet: And I called  Ian. I was like, "Hey, Ian, just letting you know   like um I don't know. I I don't think he's going  to necessarily put you on a tour

claims.label: Host Says the Side Angle Shows the Microphone Still on Kirk Afterward, Not Struck Off
claims.claim: The host says that when she first saw the footage she thought something came upward, but when she looked at the image from the side the microphone is still on Charlie Kirk afterwards; it appears to disappear but shifts and stays on him, in the fold.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original UVU event video from multiple angles, and the post-shooting photographs of the microphone's location on Kirk. Ask a forensic video analyst to compare frames.
claims.transcript_snippet: when I   looked at image from the side, the microphone is  still on him afterwards. So like when you see it   for it looks like it kind of disappears but  then it kind of shifts

claims.label: Host Says Anything Slung Into Kirk With That Force Would Have Knocked the Microphone Off, and It Did Not
claims.claim: The host says she would imagine that if anything had slung into Kirk with that kind of force, the microphone would fall off, and says it does not fall off.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask a weapons or ballistics expert how a microphone would behave under such force, and compare with the frame-by-frame video.
claims.transcript_snippet: But I would imagine if  anything did sling into him uh with that kind of   a force it would fall off. And I can tell you it  doesn't fall off.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Being Miked After He Sat Down Has Never Happened to Her at a TPUSA Event
claims.claim: The host says it is very weird that Charlie Kirk was miked after he sat down, that this never happened to her at a Turning Point event, and that they always mic you backstage.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the event video of the microphone being placed on Kirk and the sound crew's account. Compare with other TPUSA events.
claims.transcript_snippet: I do think it's very weird   that he was miked after he sat down. Tell you that  that's never happened to me at a Turning Point   event. They Mike you backstage always.

claims.label: Host Says Many Things Were Being Done for the First Time That Day and She Plans to Reveal Them
claims.claim: The host says there are a lot of things that were being done for the first time on the day of the shooting and that she plans to reveal all of them.
claims.investigative_direction: Hold the host to specifics: list each 'first time' item once revealed and check it against prior TPUSA events.
claims.transcript_snippet: There's a lot   of things that were being done for the first time  that day. And I'm going I'm planning on revealing   all of them.

memes.canonical_term: We Don't Know But We Know

occurrences.quote: Something's not right. I know it's not right. Okay. Uh, we don't know now, but we know. You know, we don't know, but we know. And ...
occurrences.context: We don't know but we know refrain. (CKA seq 11)

occurrences.quote: Jeffrey Epstein didn't kill himself. Tyler  Robinson didn't kill himself.
occurrences.context: Host cites the 'didn't kill himself' phrases as what people say when they expect the federal government is lying, and applies it to Tyler Robinson.
